description: The pie chart represents the distribution of tasks related to generative AI in journalism. It is divided into two categories: "Article generation" and "Article editing." The "Article generation" category occupies the majority of the chart with 82.9%, depicted in red, while the "Article editing" category is significantly smaller, comprising 14.6% of the chart, shown in blue. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are labeled directly on the corresponding slices. There are no visual indications of any slices being exploded, offset, or bolded, and the segments are ordered by size, with "Article generation" being the largest and "Article editing" the smallest.
